name: Universal Power: Blade of Persia
detailed_description:
NOTE: This game is developed by a 14 year old Persian boy

Step into the fires of war and shape the destiny of empires in Universal Power: Blade of Persia, an immersive action-strategy RPG set during the epic clash between the Persian Empire and the Greek Empire. In a world where every choice matters, you are not just a warrior—you are a force that will alter history.

As a soldier rising through the ranks, you must choose your path. Will you fight for the expansion of Persia’s unstoppable empire, or will you stand with Greece to defend its freedom? Lead armies into massive battles, master brutal combat, and navigate a world filled with political intrigue, betrayals, and shifting alliances. Every decision you make will have lasting consequences, determining not just your fate, but the fate of entire civilizations.


🏛 Your Choices Matter – Every action shapes the war, your reputation, and the story. Steal           from someone, and they may seek revenge, rob you back, challenge you to a fight, or               haunt you with relentless harassment. What you do today will echo in dangerous ways             tomorrow!

🌍 Expansive Open World – Roam the majestic cities, perilous landscapes, and war-torn battlegrounds of Persia and Greece. Discover hidden secrets, ancient ruins, and dangerous territories, where every corner offers new challenges, allies, and enemies in your journey through history.

⚔ Deep Combat System – Immerse yourself in brutal melee combat, strategic sieges, and large-scale battles. Master a variety of weapons, from swords to spears, and unleash devastating tactics to dominate your enemies. Every fight is a test of skill, strategy, and survival!

🎭  Narrative-Driven Adventure – Dive into a story-rich experience where every choice you make impacts the world around you. With cinematic storytelling, immersive cutscenes, and a deep, evolving plot, Universal Power: Blade of Persia pulls you into the heart of the epic clash between Persia and Greece.

Will you rise as a hero, a conqueror, or a legend lost to time? The fate of an empire is in your hands.
